snippet.title: Disciple - Official Trailer | Eldritch Horror Pachinko Roguelite
snippet.description:
Peggle meets Vampire Survivors in this eldritch horror physics roguelite. Launch your disc into the Abyss, ricochet through swarms of cosmic horrors and forge powerful builds from ancient artefacts.

Free demo coming Autumn 2026.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4518220/Disciple/
